learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the fundamental elements for recording and digitizing process data in an industrial environment, as well as their IT-based processing and analysis.
They are able to understand and independently use common tools for evaluating large data volumes based on the Python programming language.
They can apply the knowledge gained from typical application examples to future professional tasks.

syllabus_topics: Data acquisition in industrial environments (operational data acquisition) through analog and digital sensors, e.g., barcodes, 2D codes, machine and process parameters, quality features
Data transport (industrial bus, OPC UA) and storage in databases for further processing
Evaluation of large data volumes (Big Data) using statistical methods (Data Science)
Industrial image processing (Machine Vision) for analyzing 2D or 3D image data
Use of artificial intelligence (Machine Learning / Deep Learning) to optimize production and quality assurance processes (Predictive Maintenance, Classifications)
teaching_methods: Seminar-style lecture with integrated exercise sessions

assessment_methods.method: Written elaboration and presentation of a seminar topic

assessment_rules: The type of examination will be determined at the beginning of the semester. Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
